-- LOBO MAP ROTATION FRAME BEGIN
local lmr={owner="b6e004"}
function lmr.flipped()
 local o=getObjectFromGUID(lmr.owner)
 return o and o.getVar('LOBO_MAP_ROTATION_FLIPPED')==true
end
function lmr.vector(p)
 return Vector(p.x or p[1] or 0,p.y or p[2] or 0,p.z or p[3] or 0)
end
function lmr.point(p)
 local v=lmr.vector(p)
 if lmr.flipped() then v.x=-v.x;v.z=-v.z end
 return v
end
function lmr.rotation(p)
 local v=lmr.vector(p)
 if lmr.flipped() then v.y=(v.y+180)%360 end
 return v
end
function lmr.getPosition(o) return lmr.point(o.getPosition()) end
function lmr.getRotation(o) return lmr.rotation(o.getRotation()) end
function lmr.setPosition(o,p,...) return o.setPosition(lmr.point(p),...) end
function lmr.setRotation(o,p,...) return o.setRotation(lmr.rotation(p),...) end
function lmr.setPositionSmooth(o,p,...) return o.setPositionSmooth(lmr.point(p),...) end
function lmr.setRotationSmooth(o,p,...) return o.setRotationSmooth(lmr.rotation(p),...) end
function lmr.positionToLocal(o,p) return o.positionToLocal(lmr.point(p)) end
function lmr.positionToWorld(o,p) return lmr.point(o.positionToWorld(p)) end
function lmr.getBounds(o)
 local b=o.getBounds();if b and b.center then b.center=lmr.point(b.center) end;return b
end
function lmr.getTransformForward(o) return lmr.point(o.getTransformForward()) end
function lmr.getTransformRight(o) return lmr.point(o.getTransformRight()) end
function lmr.getTransformUp(o) return lmr.point(o.getTransformUp()) end
function lmr.copy(p) local q={};for k,v in pairs(p)do q[k]=v end;return q end
function lmr.cast(p)
 local q=lmr.copy(p)
 if q.origin then q.origin=lmr.point(q.origin) end
 if q.direction then q.direction=lmr.point(q.direction) end
 if q.orientation then q.orientation=lmr.rotation(q.orientation) end
 local hits=Physics.cast(q)
 for _,hit in ipairs(hits or{})do
  if hit.point then hit.point=lmr.point(hit.point)end
  if hit.normal then hit.normal=lmr.point(hit.normal)end
 end
 return hits
end
function lmr.data(d)
 if not lmr.flipped()then return d end
 local t=d.Transform
 if t then t.posX=-(t.posX or 0);t.posZ=-(t.posZ or 0);t.rotY=((t.rotY or 0)+180)%360 end
 for _,s in pairs(d.States or{})do lmr.data(s)end
 return d
end
function lmr.getData(o) return lmr.data(o.getData()) end
function lmr.getJSON(o,...) return JSON.encode(lmr.data(JSON.decode(o.getJSON(...)))) end
function lmr.spawnObjectJSON(p)
 local q=lmr.copy(p);q.json=JSON.encode(lmr.data(JSON.decode(q.json)))
 if q.position then q.position=lmr.point(q.position)end
 if q.rotation then q.rotation=lmr.rotation(q.rotation)end
 return spawnObjectJSON(q)
end
function lmr.spawnObjectData(p)
 local q=lmr.copy(p);q.data=lmr.data(q.data)
 if q.position then q.position=lmr.point(q.position)end
 if q.rotation then q.rotation=lmr.rotation(q.rotation)end
 return spawnObjectData(q)
end
function lmr.spawnObject(p)
 local q=lmr.copy(p)
 if q.position then q.position=lmr.point(q.position)end
 if q.rotation then q.rotation=lmr.rotation(q.rotation)end
 return spawnObject(q)
end
-- LOBO MAP ROTATION FRAME END
function onLoad()self.interactable=true;self.setLock(true)end

local colors={'White','Brown','Red','Orange','Yellow','Green','Teal','Blue','Purple','Pink','Grey','Black'}
local function obj(g)return g and getObjectFromGUID(g) or nil end
local function node(tag,a,k,v)return {tag=tag,attributes=a or {},children=k or {},value=v}end
local function button(id,text,fn)
 return node('Button',{id=root..id,text=text,onClick=self.getGUID()..'/'..fn,height='32',fontSize='16',color='#294351FF',textColor='#FFFFFFFF'})
end
local function currentBuilding(b)
 local c=config.buildingControls[b];if not c then return nil,1 end
 for n,g in pairs(c.states)do local o=obj(g);if o then return o,tonumber(n)end end
 return nil,1
end
local function followBuildingLights()
 for guid,entry in pairs(config.buildingLightOffsets or {})do
  local o=currentBuilding(entry.building);local light=obj(guid)
  if o and light then lmr.setPosition(light,lmr.positionToWorld(o,entry.offset))end
 end
end
local function parkPreview(p)
 p.setInvisibleTo(colors);lmr.setPosition(p,{x=90,y=-20,z=90})
end
local function previewReady(p)
 return p and p.getVar('LOBO_MERIDIAN_PREVIEW_SAFE')==true
end
local function visibilityView()
 if (Global.getVar('hld') or 0)~=0 then return end
 followBuildingLights()
 for b,c in pairs(config.buildingControls)do
  local o,n=currentBuilding(b)
  if o then
   local hidden={};local target={};local locked=o.getLock()
   for _,color in ipairs(colors)do
    local v=state.views[color] and state.views[color][b]or 0
    local want=math.min(n,math.max(1,c.maxState-v))
    local p=obj((config.privateProxies[b]or {})[tostring(want)])
    if want~=n and (not locked or not previewReady(p))then want=n end
    target[color]=want;if want~=n then hidden[#hidden+1]=color end
   end
   o.setInvisibleTo(hidden)
   for phase,g in pairs(config.privateProxies[b]or {})do
    local p=obj(g)
    if p then
     local hide={};local show=false
     for _,color in ipairs(colors)do
      if target[color]~=tonumber(phase)or n==tonumber(phase)then hide[#hide+1]=color else show=true end
     end
     if show and locked and previewReady(p)then
      lmr.setPosition(p,lmr.getPosition(o));lmr.setRotation(p,lmr.getRotation(o));p.setScale(o.getScale());p.setInvisibleTo(hide)
     else parkPreview(p)end
    end
   end
  end
 end
end
local movementSignatures={}
local function followMovedBuildings()
 if (Global.getVar('hld') or 0)~=0 then return end
 local changed=false
 for b in pairs(config.buildingControls)do
  local o=currentBuilding(b)
  if o then
   local p=lmr.getPosition(o);local r=lmr.getRotation(o);local s=o.getScale()
   local signature=string.format('%s:%.4f:%.4f:%.4f:%.4f:%.4f:%.4f:%.4f:%.4f:%.4f',o.getGUID(),p.x,p.y,p.z,r.x,r.y,r.z,s.x,s.y,s.z)
   signature=signature..':'..tostring(o.getLock())
   for phase=1,config.buildingControls[b].maxState do
    local p=obj((config.privateProxies[b]or {})[tostring(phase)])
    signature=signature..':'..tostring(previewReady(p))
   end
   if movementSignatures[b]~=signature then movementSignatures[b]=signature;changed=true end
  end
 end
 if changed then visibilityView()end
end
function onObjectPickUp(player_color,object)
 if not object then return end
 local guid=object.getGUID()
 for _,c in pairs(config.buildingControls)do
  for _,g in pairs(c.states)do if g==guid then visibilityView();return end end
 end
end
local function draw()
 local mat=obj(config.mat);if not mat then return end
 local lines={}
 local function line(x1,z1,x2,z2,c,w,kind)
  if kind then loboInk(mat,lines,{{x1,.025,z1},{x2,.025,z2}},kind);return end
  lines[#lines+1]={points={{x=x1,y=.025,z=z1},{x=x2,y=.025,z=z2}},color=c,thickness=w or .025,rotation={0,0,0}}
 end
 
 if state.scoring then line(0,-24,0,24,{.95,.72,.3},.035,'scoring');line(-24,0,24,0,{.95,.72,.3},.035,'scoring')end
 if state.deployment then
  local d=12-state.extension
  if not (state.exclusion and d==4) then line(-d,-24,-d,24,{.25,.65,1},.045,'deployment');line(d,-24,d,24,{1,.4,.3},.045,'deployment')end
 end
 if state.exclusion then line(-4,-24,-4,24,{.9,.4,.7},.035,'exclusion');line(4,-24,4,24,{.9,.4,.7},.035,'exclusion')end
 loboZoneWrite(mat,lines)
end
local function refresh()
 local nodes={}
 for _,n in ipairs(UI.getXmlTable() or {})do if not n.attributes or n.attributes.id~=root then nodes[#nodes+1]=n end end
 local children={button('_mission','Last Launch briefing','meridianMission'),
  button('_dep0','Standard'..(state.deployment and state.extension==0 and ': ON' or ': OFF'),'loboUniversalDeployment0'),
  button('_dep4','+4 in'..(state.deployment and state.extension==4 and ': ON' or ': OFF'),'loboUniversalDeployment4'),
  button('_dep8','+8 in'..(state.deployment and state.extension==8 and ': ON' or ': OFF'),'loboUniversalDeployment8'),
  button('_dz','Deployment Zones: '..(state.deployment and 'ON' or 'OFF'),'meridianDZToggle'),
  button('_score','Quadrants: '..(state.scoring and 'ON' or 'OFF'),'meridianScoring'),
  button('_exclusion','Exclusion reference: '..(state.exclusion and 'ON' or 'OFF'),'meridianExclusion'),
  button('_physical','Shared interiors: '..({'Closed','Upper floors','Ground floors'})[state.physical+1],'meridianPhysical')}
 for _,mode in ipairs({'day','night','off'})do children[#children+1]=button('_'..mode,mode,'loboChooseBackground')end
 for color,reader in pairs(readers)do
  local body={node('Text',{height='45',fontSize='23',color='#EDCB89FF'},nil,reader=='mission' and 'LAST LAUNCH  -  PORT MERIDIAN' or 'MY VIEW  -  '..color)}
  if reader=='mission' then
   body[#body+1]=node('Text',{height='300',fontSize='17',alignment='UpperLeft',color='#FFFFFFFF'},nil,
    'The Evening Star is making its final departure.\n\nPlay the current official Last Launch scenario. The centre pavilion is the 8 x 8 in Launching Tower, with four open Wide Gates and infinitely high walls for LoF. Its roof is not playable.\n\nTwo 40 mm ID Scanners sit on the centre line, 8 in from each flank edge. The 40 mm ID Checker is at the pavilion centre. Keep silhouette contact clear.\n\nThe shuttle is scenery. Extraction uses the ID Checker.\n\nStandard deployment is 12 in from opposing X edges. Quadrants and exclusion markings are optional references; they add no scenario rules.')
  else
   body[#body+1]=node('Text',{height='52',fontSize='15',color='#BDCBD1FF'},nil,'Private appearance: Full -> Roof off -> Ground floor.\nUse Shared interiors for physical access to rooms.')
   for _,b in ipairs(config.buildings)do
    local v=state.views[color] and state.views[color][b.key] or 0
    body[#body+1]=button('_view_'..b.key,b.label..': '..({'Full','Roof off','Ground'})[v+1],'meridianMyView')
   end
  end
  body[#body+1]=button('_close_'..color,'Close','meridianClose')
  children[#children+1]=node('Panel',{id=root..'_detail_'..color,rectAlignment='MiddleCenter',width='540',height=reader=='mission' and '440' or '540',color='#10212AFB',visibility=color,active='true',allowDragging='true'},
   {node('VerticalLayout',{padding='18 18 14 14',spacing='5',childForceExpandHeight='false',childForceExpandWidth='true'},body)})
 end
 nodes[#nodes+1]=node('Panel',{id=root,width='100%',height='100%',color='#00000000',raycastTarget='false'},children)
 UI.setXmlTable(nodes)
end
function meridianDZToggle()state.deployment=not state.deployment;draw();refresh()end
function meridianScoring()state.scoring=not state.scoring;draw();refresh()end
function meridianExclusion()state.exclusion=not state.exclusion;draw();refresh()end
local function deployment(n)if state.deployment and state.extension==n then state.deployment=false else state.deployment=true;state.extension=n end;draw();refresh()end
function loboUniversalDeployment0()deployment(0)end
function loboUniversalDeployment4()deployment(4)end
function loboUniversalDeployment8()deployment(8)end
function meridianMission(p)if p and p.color then readers[p.color]='mission';refresh()end end
function meridianViewMenu(p)if p and p.color then readers[p.color]='view';refresh()end end
function meridianClose(p)if p and p.color then readers[p.color]=nil;refresh()end end
function meridianMyView(p,value,id)
 if not p or not p.color then return end
 local b=id:match('_view_(.+)$');if not b then return end
 state.views[p.color]=state.views[p.color] or {};local v=state.views[p.color]
 v[b]=((v[b] or 0)+1)%3;visibilityView();refresh()
end
function meridianNativeBuildingState(p)
 local c=config.buildingControls[p.building]
 if not c or c.states[tostring(p.state)]~=p.guid then return end
 Wait.frames(visibilityView,2);refresh()
end
function meridianPhysical()
 state.physical=(state.physical+1)%3
 for b,c in pairs(config.buildingControls)do
  local o,n=currentBuilding(b);local want=math.max(1,c.maxState-state.physical)
  if o and c.maxState>1 and n~=want then o.setState(want)end
 end
 Wait.frames(visibilityView,2);refresh()
end
function loboChooseBackground(p,value,id)
 local mode=id:match('_([^_]+)$');if not config.background[mode] then return end
 local result=loboLifeCall('loboBackgroundActivate',{config=config.background,mode=mode})
 if result then state.mode=mode end
 for _,g in ipairs(config.lights)do local o=obj(g);if o then o.call('setBillboardLight',{enabled=mode~='off'})end end
 refresh()
end
local handlers={meridianMission=meridianMission,meridianDZToggle=meridianDZToggle,meridianScoring=meridianScoring,meridianExclusion=meridianExclusion,meridianViewMenu=meridianViewMenu,meridianPhysical=meridianPhysical,
 loboUniversalDeployment0=loboUniversalDeployment0,loboUniversalDeployment4=loboUniversalDeployment4,loboUniversalDeployment8=loboUniversalDeployment8,loboChooseBackground=loboChooseBackground}
function loboDrawerAction(p,value,id)
 local route=loboLifeCall('loboDrawerResolve',{id=id,color=p and p.color})
 local fn=route and handlers[route.callback];if fn then fn(p,value,id)end
end
function onLoad(saved)
 LOBO_MERIDIAN_READY=false
 for _,old in ipairs(getObjectsWithTag('LoboMap:PortMeridianR1')or {})do old.destruct()end
 if saved and saved~='' then
  local ok,data=pcall(JSON.decode,saved)
  if ok and data then state=data.state or state;config=data.config or config end
 end
 self.interactable=false;self.setInvisibleTo(colors)
 local broker=loboLifeGetBroker()
 Wait.condition(function()
  loboLifeToken=broker.call('loboUIRegister',{owner=self.getGUID(),anchor=config.mat,mapName="Port Meridian",mission="Last Launch",mapTag="LoboMap:100ca1"})
  loboLifeCall('loboBackgroundActivate',{config=config.background,mode=state.mode})
  LOBO_MERIDIAN_READY=true;draw();visibilityView();refresh()
  Wait.time(followMovedBuildings,.2,-1)
 end,function()broker=loboLifeGetBroker();return broker and not broker.isDestroyed() and broker.getVar('LOBO_UI_STANDARD_REVISION')=='lobo-standard-20261118-v1' and obj(config.mat)~=nil and (Global.getVar('hld') or 0)==0 end,90)
end
function onSave()return JSON.encode({state=state,config=config})end
function onDestroy()

   {'scoring','Quadrants','loboStandardScoring'},{'clear','Clear Table','loboStandardClear'}})do
   children[#children+1]={tag='Button',attributes={id=id..'_'..item[1],text=item[2],onClick=self.getGUID()..'/'..item[3],width='326',height='34'}}

  if busy then restoreLocks()end

 end

  if busy then restoreLocks()end
  if oldDestroy then oldDestroy()end
 end
